title: Travel Loyalty Login
scenario: A points blog comment links to a bonus tracker requiring airline login.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Travel Loyalty Login: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Do not enter loyalty credentials on third-party trackers.
